```{css, echo=FALSE}
/* ---- Lesson color palette ---- */
:root {
  --blue: #5BAFF8;   --dark-blue: #3070BF;
  --pink: #EF85B3;   --pink2: #BF396F;
  --orange:  #C44546; --red: #C83532;
  --green: #367B79;  --green2: #459B99;
  --ivory: #FDF3F2;
  --coral-text: #C44546;
}

.title{
  font-size: 30px;
  color: #3070BF;
  background-color: #fff;
  padding: 0px;
}

/* Main headers: block of color */
.sec-blue  { --sec: var(--dark-blue); --sec-text: var(--dark-blue); }
.sec-coral { --sec: var(--orange);    --sec-text: var(--coral-text); } /* darker coral for text */
.sec-green { --sec: var(--green);     --sec-text: var(--green); }
section.level2 > h2 {
  background-color: var(--sec, var(--dark-blue));
  color: white;
  padding: 0.45em 0.8em;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border-bottom: none;
  margin-top: 2rem;
}
section.level2 p strong { color: var(--sec-text, var(--dark-blue)); }

/* ---- Timeline: Lab 1 -> ... -> Final project ---- */
.timeline {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.5rem 1.75rem;
  margin: 0.5rem 0 1.5rem 0;
}
.step {
  position: relative;
  flex: 1 1 110px;
  background-color: white;
  color: var(--dark-blue);
  border: 2px solid var(--dark-blue);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 0.6rem 0.8rem;
  text-align: center;
}
.step p { margin: 0; }
.step a { color: var(--dark-blue) !important; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.1rem; text-decoration: none; }
.step a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.step .when { display: block; font-size: 0.9rem; color: #495057; }
.step:not(:last-child)::after {
  content: "\279C";
  position: absolute;
  right: -1.45rem;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  color: #ADB5BD;
  font-size: 1.2rem;
}

/* ---- Labs table ---- */
.labs table thead th {
  background-color: var(--orange);
  color: white;
  border-bottom: none;
}
.labs table tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background-color: var(--ivory); }
.labs table td { vertical-align: middle; }
.labs table td:nth-child(2),
.labs table td:nth-child(3),
.labs table td:nth-child(4),
.labs table th:nth-child(2),
.labs table th:nth-child(3),
.labs table th:nth-child(4) { text-align: center; }
.labs table td:nth-child(5) { font-weight: 700; color: var(--coral-text); }

/* ---- Final project buttons ---- */
.proj-links { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.75rem; margin: 1rem 0; }
.proj-links p { margin: 0; }
.proj-btn {
  display: inline-block;
  color: white !important;
  background-color: var(--btn);
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  padding: 0.6em 1.2em;
  border-radius: 12px;
}
.proj-btn:hover { filter: brightness(0.9); }
.b-blue  { --btn: var(--dark-blue); }
.b-green { --btn: var(--green); }
.b-pink  { --btn: var(--pink2); }
```

## Labs {.sec-coral}

The labs are meant to scaffold and build the work needed to complete the final project. This will help us complete the work over the quarter instead of all at the end! **If you receive feedback on something in a lab, it is expected to be fixed for the next lab and final project.**
